title: minuartia glabra
intro: Minuartia glabra, commonly known as Sticky St. Peter's-wort, is a flowering plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The bioactive constituents of Minuartia glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-oxidative and anti-cancer activities. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects, making it a promising candidate for further research in traditional medicine.
